If you get them during this period of time, they will be in your [u]save file permanently[/u], however if you miss out on the opportunity you will not be able to unlock it after the [b]10 days[/b].
[/h3]

[h3][u][b]Update:[/b][/u] The ability to purchase Halloween items is valid for the [b]account[/b]. If you have already completed the Halloween event within the game, [u]for different game saves[/u], you can buy items even after the official end of the event.[/h3]
